notes.title: BELLATORES CBT Successfully Concludes!
notes.notes: [p]Hello, this is BELLATORES.[/p][p][/p][p]The first CBT for BELLATORES, which began on July 30th, has successfully concluded thanks to the great interest and participation of many players.[/p][p][/p][p]We extend our sincere gratitude to everyone who dedicated their valuable time to participate in the test and provided us with various feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]The gameplay data collected through the CBT, along with the diverse opinions you shared, will be invaluable resources in further enhancing the quality and completeness of BELLATORES.[/p][p][/p][p]If you have any additional feedback, please feel free to send it to the email address below, and we will carefully review it:  [/p][p] - E-MAIL: bellatores@nyouinc.com [/p][p][/p][p]Based on the various data and feedback gathered from this CBT, we will continue to develop an even more refined BELLATORES.[/p][p][/p][p]We will keep you updated on future news and developments through the official BELLATORES social media channels and YouTube. Please stay tuned for more exciting news![/p][p][/p][p]Once again, we deeply appreciate the immense support you've shown for BELLATORES. Please look forward to the day we return with an even better game.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Accelerated Growth Support NPC Usage Guide
notes.notes: [p]Hello, this is BELLATORES.[/p][p][/p][p]First, we extend our sincerest gratitude to everyone who showed interest and participated as a tester in the first BELLATORES CBT.[/p][p][/p][p]The CBT, which began on July 30th, now has only two days remaining.[/p][p][/p][p]For those who might feel they haven't had enough time to fully enjoy all the diverse content during the test period, we're excited to offer an 'Accelerated Growth Support System' to ensure you can experience even richer content in the remaining time.[/p][p][/p][p]Starting from August 2 at 14:00, you can access the following features through the 'Suspicious Wizard' NPC, located in the major cities of each faction:[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Suspicious Wizard NPC Locations][/b][/p][p] - Grecia > Goldentail[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681596/b9c55aed8abdc1c3fb7fc3c4f25252c54fd53ff6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] - Lazuli > Tesalia[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681596/27a807ce8d2e0a4f305d0de30b1e1fd994af6ffd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Support System][/b][/p][p]  1. Accelerated Growth[/p][p]    - Boost your character's proficiency to the highest tier.[/p][p]    - Unlock all content and open up the entire world map.[/p][p]    - Receive high-grade equipment, currency, item enhancement materials, movement scrolls, and other accelerated growth support items.[/p][p][/p][p]  2. Item Purchase[/p][p]    - Affordable Purchases: You can buy additional items, beyond those initially granted by 'Accelerated Growth,' at an affordable price to further enhance your character.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you'll take full advantage of the Accelerated Growth Support System to enjoy smoother progression and a wider range of content during the final days of the CBT.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: BELLATORES CBT Has Begun!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, this is BELLATORES.[/p][p][/p][p]The BELLATORES CBT has officially started! [/p][p][/p][p]We're providing you with a guide to the main content schedule during the CBT period, so please refer to it as you play.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[CBT Schedule][/b][/p][p] - July 30th (Wed) 14:00 KST ~ August 3rd (Sun) 22:00 KST[/p][p]*Please send any bugs or feedback you find during the test to the email address below:
 - E-MAIL: [url="https://bellatores@nyouinc.com"]bellatores@nyouinc.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Main Content Schedule]
1. Fast Growth Guide NPC[/b][/p][p] - A 'Suspicious Wizard' NPC is located in the major cities of each faction and provides guides for key content.[/p][p] - Starting August 2nd (Sat) at 14:00 KST, the 'Growth' and 'Item Purchase' functions will open.[/p][p]   * Growth: Supports growth items such as achieving maximum proficiency, unlocking all content, opening all regions of the world map, and receiving high-grade items.[/p][p]   * Item Purchase: Allows you to purchase additional items you need from those provided through the 'Growth' function.[/p][p][/p][p][b]2. Occupation War (Faction-based Battle)[/b][/p][p] - Held daily at 20:00 KST in the Occupation War Zone.[/p][p] - Victory is achieved by occupying and activating the Holy Object within the occupied castle and reaching 100% occupation progress.[/p][p][/p][p][b]3. Territory War (Guild-based Battle)[/b][/p][p] - Held daily at 22:00 KST in each faction's hunting grounds.[/p][p] - Guild leaders can apply for Territory War participation via the Territory War UI displayed on the right side of the screen, starting 10 minutes before the war begins.[/p][p] - When the Territory War starts, all guild members of the applying guild will be forcibly moved to the Territory War world.[/p][p] - Accumulate attack points by attacking the 'Heart of the Earth' (object-type monster). The guild with the most accumulated points wins (lasts for 20 minutes).[/p][p]  * A minimum of 10,000 attack points is required to occupy the Heart of the Earth.[/p][p][/p][p][b]4. Boss Raids[/b][/p][p] - Bosses appear daily at 12:00 KST, 18:00 KST, and 24:00 KST.[/p][p] - Anyone can participate without special conditions, and rewards are obtained upon defeating the boss.[/p][p]  * You can check their locations on the world map.[/p][p]  * Starting August 2nd at 14:00 KST, you can use movement scroll items from the 'Content Movement Scroll Support Box' provided and sold by the Fast Growth Guide NPC to move directly to these locations.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: BELLATORES CBT Tester Recruitment Announcement
notes.notes: [p]Hello, this is BELLATORES.[/p][p][/p][p]Recruitment for BELLATORES' first CBT (Closed Beta Test) testers has begun.[/p][p][/p][p]If you wish to participate in the test, you can apply through the BELLATORES Steam page until July 28th at 14:00 KST.[/p][p][/p][p]Please note that this CBT will only be available to users in the Korean region for smooth testing, and only Korean language will be supported.[/p][p][/p][p]Support for various languages will be provided in the official release version later.[/p][p][/p][p]Here's how to apply for the test:[/p][p][/p][p]  1. Log in to your Steam account.[/p][p]  2. Go to the BELLATORES Store Page.[/p][p]  3. Click the "Request Access" button.[/p][p][/p][p]This test will be playable on PC via the Steam Playtest feature.[/p][p][/p][p]\[CBT Schedule][/p][p]  - Tester Application Deadline: July 28th (Mon) 14:00 KST[/p][p]  - CBT Period: July 30th (Wed) 14:00 KST ~ August 3rd (Sun) 22:00 KST[/p][p][/p][p]Tester selection will take place on July 29th, and those selected as testers will be notified via the email registered on their Steam account.[/p][p][/p][p]Your valuable participation will greatly help us enhance the quality of BELLATORES. We kindly ask for your strong interest and participation.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: BELLATORES Developer Interview Video Revealed
notes.notes: [p]Hello, this is BELLATORES.[/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely thank everyone who has been patiently waiting for BELLATORES for a long time. [/p][p]Our official Steam page for BELLATORES has now opened, ready for our journey with you all.[/p][p][/p][p]To mark the beginning of this exciting adventure, we are revealing the BELLATORES Developer Interview video.[/p][p][/p][p]In this video, you can learn about BELLATORES' development goals, worldview, key features, and information regarding the CBT scheduled for July 30th.[/p][p]Please note that this CBT will be conducted for the Korean region only.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="BZymINh_k8Q;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]As you saw in the video, applications for BELLATORES' first CBT testers will begin on July 8th.[/p][p][/p][p]Furthermore, if you add BELLATORES to your Steam Wishlist, you will be able to receive the fastest updates on CBT schedules and game-related news, so don't forget to add it![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]
